title: Thor in the Hall of Utgarda Loki
text:
Thor, the strongest of the gods, traveled to the giants' stronghold of Utgard with Loki and his young servant Thjalfi. The giant king, Utgarda Loki, received them with contempt and told them no one could stay unless he excelled at something.

Loki said he could eat faster than anyone, and was matched against a man named Logi. Both ate from a trough of meat, but while Loki ate the meat, Logi ate the meat, the bones and the trough. Thjalfi raced a youth named Hugi three times and was beaten badly each time. Thor was given a drinking horn and told that a good drinker emptied it in one draught. After three huge gulps, the level had barely dropped. He was told to lift the king's cat, and managed to raise only one paw. Then he wrestled the king's old nurse, Elli, and was forced down onto one knee. They went to bed humiliated.

In the morning, as he saw them off, Utgarda Loki told them the truth. Logi was fire itself, which consumes everything. Hugi was the king's own thought, which no one can outrun. The end of the horn reached the sea, and Thor's drinking had lowered the ocean. The cat was the World Serpent that encircles the earth. Elli was old age, which brings everyone down. Thor raised his hammer in fury, but the king and his castle had vanished.
lesson: Before judging a defeat, find out what you were really up against. Sometimes a narrow loss means you nearly moved the sea.
